a:r.a:t: The education and qualifications authority which reviews all the institutions in the Kingdom, gives the feedback in three categories - DSR (Schools) DHR (Higher eductaion) DVR (Vocational Training). The Review is made as per the prequisites on evaluation of the institution, and it is done on a physical visit basis, which is a lengthy process.
The company is automating this process of review management system, by making the process all accessible in cloud and real time.
All the modules and chapters of the review management systems are being inserted and are made available in the platform.
This will make the process, fast, efficient and accurate.
